LESSON: PRODUCTION UNIT

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Entrepreneurship 5.1 Introduction to Entrepreneurship (4 lessons) By the end of 
Topic 5.2: Production Unit
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Production Unit, part of Entrepreneurship 5.1 Introduction to Entrepreneurship (4 lessons) By the end of  in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How is the size of a production unit determined?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Production Unit together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: learner acquires speaking, writing, listening, and teamwork skills when discussing and

presenting on the meaning of the term ‘production unit’.

• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: learner acquires interpretation and inference skills when visiting the local

community to assess the factors that influenced the location of a particular production unit.

Values:
• Responsibility: learner shows accountability when using print or digital media to search for information on the factors that

determine its size and share with peers.

• Respect: learner shows regard for the input of every member when brainstorming and presenting on the factors considered

when choosing the location of a production unit.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Financial Literacy: learner develops entrepreneurial skills when brainstorming and presenting the factors considered when

choosing the location of a production unit.

Social Studies: learner enhances knowledge on trade when brainstorm on factors considered when choosing the location of a

production unit.
